speaker: Doctor
text: To start our investigation, can you describe exactly how your walking has changed and when these symptoms first began? Additionally, do you experience any specific neurological symptoms like double vision, slurred speech, or numbness in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Have you noticed any difficulty swallowing, slurred speech, or double vision accompanying your ataxia? Additionally, do you have a history of stroke, cancer, or immunodeficiency disorders?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Vitamin_B12_Level, Paraneoplastic_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your basic labs are normal, have you experienced any recent weight loss, fevers, or skin rashes that might suggest an underlying systemic condition like lupus or a malignancy?

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain, PET_Scan

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That history is a major red flag; natalizumab carries a significant risk for Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Do you recall developing new symptoms like vision loss, weakness, or cognitive changes since starting the medication?

REQUEST TEST: JC_Virus_Serology, Brain_Spinal_Fluid_Analysis
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain_With_Enhancement_Sequence
